raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Lessons from the Humanize 2 / Flame Chase explainer (2026-10-29, 50 frames, 13:23).

- **Captions patch:** `LATIN_EDGE` now includes `@` and `-`, so groups read `用 @flow` and `两个 -a` instead of `用@flow` / `两个-a`. The patched line is an added line, so the patch still applies (`git apply --check -R` passes on the applied tree).
- **Caption skins:** the runtime seam test in `assets/caption-skin.html` (and the kimi-dark skin) decides the gap per word span, so it now uses the same set (`_ + @ -`); the build-time fix alone left the render unspaced.
- **Troubleshooting:**
  - Edge's WordBoundary drops a leading `-` on CLI flags (like the known leading `/`); fix by prefixing the word text in the three meta files.
  - `pron_check --asr` fails with a SOCKS `all_proxy`; run it with `env -u all_proxy -u ALL_PROXY HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1`.
- **Pronunciation reword rows:** an English tagline read as a sentence, pytest, done, resume, chasoid, epoch, tree — all pron_check FAILs in this video, fixed by Chinese rewording.
- **Worker lessons:** size images to the card's inner width (3 frames overflowed by ~13 px); crop web-figure footnotes; no fixed-height terminal bodies with `overflow:hidden` (a key line was clipped); never `pkill` by a generic script name across concurrent workers.

@@ -35,3 +35,7 @@
 | One line is re-voiced after its frame was already built, while other frames were built on the newer take | a whole-project `retime_frames.py --ref-meta <old take>` would also warp the frames built on the newer take | snapshot `audio_meta.built.json` before the re-TTS, then retime only that frame: `retime_frames.py --project $P --ref-meta <snapshot> --frames <fid>=<frame N>` (PR 37909 video, 2026-10-24) |
 | `assemble-index` warns the total lands N% over the brief's expectation | the brief's `length` is only an estimate | expected when the material needs it — update `length:` in BRIEF/STORYBOARD; never trim content to hit it |
 | `code-typing` block missing in the project | `hf add` was skipped or ran outside `$P` | run `(cd $P && hf add code-typing)` before packets, or let the worker inline an adapted typing engine |
+| Captions show `两个-a` / `用@flow` with no gap | `LATIN_EDGE` in the captions patch treated `-` and `@` as CJK-side characters | patch now includes `@` and `-` in `LATIN_EDGE`; rebuild captions (and update any caption-translations keys that changed) |
+| Captions show `f 选 flow` for a spoken CLI flag `-f` | Edge's WordBoundary drops a leading `-` the way it drops a leading `/` | before captions/build, prefix the word text with `-` in `audio_meta.json`, `audio_meta.built.json` and `audio_engine_meta.json` (the audio is unchanged), or say 杠 f |
+| `pron_check.py --asr`: `ImportError: Using SOCKS proxy, but the 'socksio' package is not installed` | an `all_proxy=socks5://…` in the shell makes huggingface_hub build a SOCKS client even for the cached Whisper model | run it as `env -u all_proxy -u ALL_PROXY HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 $SEV_PY -I …/pron_check.py …` (keep the http proxies: Edge still needs them) |
+| Closing frame suddenly ends right after the voice | a subset re-TTS (`EDGE_TTS_PAD_LAST=0`) included the film's LAST line, which lost its 2 s tail | pad that wav back (`ffmpeg -af apad=pad_dur=2`), add 2.0 to its `duration_s` in `audio_meta.json` + `audio_engine_meta.json`, retime, then copy to `audio_meta.built.json` |

@@ -151,3 +151,14 @@ earlier film. The project's `dispatch.py` keeps the full list.
 
 Retry (once per frame): SendMessage to the same worker with the exact validator/lint finding and the
 check command; ask it to change only what the finding names.
+- Size a real image to the card's INNER width (Humanize 2 video, 2026-10-29): three frames gave a 12 px-padded card
+  the image's full width under `box-sizing:border-box`, so each figure stuck out of its card by ~13 px. Tell workers:
+  img width = card width − 2 × padding − 2 × border; or widen the card. Crop web-figure footnotes such as "Hover, tap
+  or use the arrow keys…" off the PNG before handing it to workers (crop the bottom only, so pointer-box coordinates
+  measured from the top stay valid).
+- A terminal / code body with a fixed `height` and `overflow:hidden` clips its last line (same video: the key line of a
+  three-line prompt was cut for the whole frame). Size bodies from the line count, or leave the height auto.
+- Never `pkill -f <generic script name>` in a worker: two workers named their preview script `shot.mjs` and one killed
+  the other's run. Stop only the PIDs you started.
+- Don't put the same sentence in the title slot and again right under it: when a frame's Scene shows a tagline that
+  equals the frame title, let the title carry it.

@@ -167,3 +167,25 @@ def test_ack_is_spelled():
     assert spoken("等所有 rank 的 ack 到齐") == "等所有 rank 的 A C K 到齐"
     assert spoken("回一个 ABORT_ACK。") == "回一个 Abort A-C-K。"
     assert spoken("单边 RDMA WRITE") == "单边 RDMA WRITE"
+
+
+def test_version_two_after_a_product_name_is_er():
+    # Edge reads "Humanize 2 把关系" as 两把 (the classifier pulls 2 to 两); a version number is 二
+    assert spoken("Humanize 2 把关系倒了过来") == "Humanize 二把关系倒了过来"
+    assert spoken("这就是 Humanize 2 里的 Flame Chase。") == "这就是 Humanize 二里的 Flame Chase。"
+    assert spoken("下一步是 Humanize 2，把 flow") == "下一步是 Humanize 二，把 flow"
+    # counts, acronyms and decimals keep their digit
+    assert spoken("agent 2 个") == "agent 2 个"
+    assert spoken("GPU 2 个") == "GPU 2 个"
+    assert spoken("Humanize 2.5") == "Humanize 2.5"
+
+
+def test_cli_is_spelled_as_letters():
+    # the user asked for C L I (Humanize 2 video review, 2026-10-30)
+    assert spoken("审查要靠另一个 Codex CLI。") == "审查要靠另一个 Codex C L I。"
+    assert spoken("而且每个 CLI 都能用") == "而且每个 C L I 都能用"
+
+
+def test_callback_huidiao():
+    # 回调 (callback) must be huí diào; Edge read it tiáo in 2/6 takes (Humanize 2 video review, 2026-10-30)
+    assert spoken("变成了一个 Python 回调：") == "变成了一个 Python 回掉："
